headline: Autodesk Beats Q3 Estimates and Raises Guidance as Stock Declines
summary: Autodesk reported third-quarter financial results that topped consensus expectations and raised its full-year guidance, though its shares slipped in late trading.
why: Autodesk is a global provider of design software for architecture and manufacturing, serving as a demand benchmark for industrial software.

impacts.name: Autodesk
impacts.why: Shares fell post-market despite beating quarterly profit estimates and raising outlook.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Autodesk shares slipped after hours as market participants weighed broader tech valuation pressures against raised financial guidance.
